title: Employ staff under the Ports, Harbours and Enclosed Water Vessels Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Ports, Harbours and Enclosed Water Vessels Award 2020.

laws.title: Ports, Harbours and Enclosed Water Vessels Award 2020

sources.title: Ports, Harbours and Enclosed Water Vessels Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in respect of their operations in the ports, harbours and enclosed water vessels industry and their employees in the classifications listed in clause 14 — Minimum rates to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.condition: vessels operated wholly or substantially within a port, harbour or other body of water (cl 4.2)
reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Ports, Harbours and Enclosed Water Vessels Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 For the purpose of clause 4.1 , ports, harbours and enclosed water vessels industry means the operation of vessels of any type wholly or substantially within a port, harbour or other body of water within the Australian coastline

sources.title: Ports, Harbours and Enclosed Water Vessels Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 For the purpose of clause 4.1 , ports, harbours and enclosed water vessels industry means the operation of vessels of any type wholly or substantially within a port, harbour or other body of water within the Australian coastline or at sea on activities not covered by the awards listed in clauses 4.3 and 4.4..

reach.condition: vessels operated wholly or substantially within a port, harbour or other body of water (cl 4.2)
reach.note: Unincorporated employers outside WA (in WA they are in the state system).

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Ports, Harbours and Enclosed Water Vessels Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.

assessment.confidence_note: Economic reasoning and desk research only; no evaluation of this requirement found. Drafted 12 Nov 2026 from the award's coverage clause, not yet checked.
